title: Building Knowledge-Guided Lexica to Model Cultural Variation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting an LLM (GPT-3.5) with geographic personas representing specific US states (New York, Massachusetts, Louisiana, Mississippi) to generate tweets, then scoring the generated text for the cultural dimensions of individualism and collectivism using a custom knowledge-guided lexicon. The scores are compared against real-world social media and survey data to reveal that the LLM relies on superficial regional stereotypes rather than accurately reflecting genuine cultural variation.
